:::{#exm-negative-imaginary-unit}
#### Squaring $i$ and $-i$ in R

R has the imaginary unit as `1i`.
The code below squares it and its negative.

```{r}
#| label: negative-imaginary-unit
#| code-fold: false
squares <- c(i = (1i)^2, minus_i = (-1i)^2)
squares
```

Both squares have real part `{r} Re(squares[["i"]])`
and imaginary part `{r} Im(squares[["i"]])`,
as @def-imaginary-unit and @thm-negative-imaginary-unit say.

:::
